description: PUT /v1/devices/self/push-tokens — role: viewer/owner. Registers the CALLER's own device-level APNs tokens; there is no device_id field in the body (v1-architecture.md §2.3). Also includes the companion PUT /v1/tasks/:id/live-activity-token for the per-activity token, which is a separate route/table (§1.1).

per_activity_live_activity_token.note: Keyed by task_id in the path — replaces the old POST /v2/activities {source_id, token} body form. Distinct table (activity_tokens) from push_tokens; a second PUT for the same task_id from a different device replaces the first (v1-architecture.md §1.1, known single-viewer limitation).
